title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
summary: Central Bank of India reported a 21% rise in September 2026 quarterly net profit to Rs 1,469 crore, supported by 26% net interest income growth and 30% loan expansion. Asset quality improved, with net NPA declining to 0.31%, while operating efficiency strengthened.

title: Christmas cheer, but caution remains: Exporters welcome US tariff relief, keep diversification plans

title: India notifies first tariff cuts under New Zealand FTA
summary: India will implement duty concessions for certain imports from New Zealand starting October 20, under a new FTA. The concessions include zero basic customs duty for sheep meat and specific rates for fish and wine. Additionally, provisions have been made for manuka honey and kiwi fruit imports with varying duties. Sensitive categories like dairy products are excluded from this trade liberalization
